invariants: Every page round-trips the CSRF token.

themes.title: Country of origin
themes.why: req-001 to req-004 change only the origin pages and the notification's origin fields.

themes.title: Commodity details
themes.why: req-005 to req-008 change only the commodity pages; the region list reads the origin country.

themes.title: Accompanying documents
themes.why: req-009 changes only the documents page and its tests.

increments.title: Ask for the country of origin
increments.detail: An importer says which country the plants come from, so the inspector knows which rules apply.
acceptanceCriteria: The origin page asks "Which country are the plants from?" (confluence:6518997274 §Origin)

increments.title: Ask for the region of origin
increments.detail: An importer whose country has regions says which one, so the inspector can check regional rules.
acceptanceCriteria: The origin page asks for a region when the country has regions (confluence:6518997274 §Origin)

increments.title: Ask for the commodity code
increments.detail: An importer gives the commodity code, so the notification names what is imported.
acceptanceCriteria: The commodity page asks for an 8-digit commodity code (confluence:6518997274 §Commodity)

increments.title: Ask for the quantity
increments.detail: An importer gives how many plants arrive, so the inspector can plan the check.
acceptanceCriteria: The commodity page asks for the number of plants (confluence:6518997274 §Commodity)

increments.title: Upload a phytosanitary certificate
increments.detail: An importer uploads the certificate, so the inspector sees it before the plants arrive.
acceptanceCriteria: The documents page accepts a PDF up to 10MB (confluence:6518997274 §Documents)

increments.title: Show the documents page
increments.detail: An importer reaches the documents page from the task list.
acceptanceCriteria: The task list links to the documents page (confluence:6518997274 §Documents)
